name: Vehicle Registration
description: Register a vehicle with Transpordiamet (Estonian Transport Authority). The vehicle is looked up from a curated catalog; adult sole owners of low-value (under €5k) older (10+ years) vehicles are auto-approved by DMN, everyone else routes to a Transport Authority review queue.

variables.title: vehicleRegistration start-time variables
variables.description: Variables collected from the registering owner. The engine sets `initiator` from the authenticated user automatically; never include it in start_process input. The owner's first name, last name, and email are filled automatically from their signed-in Keycloak account at process start — do NOT ask the user for them and do NOT send them (they are not accepted here, and the engine re-validates them on task completion).

age.description: Registering owner's age in years. Drives the auto-approval branch (adults only).

objectId.description: Vehicle VIN. The engine looks the vehicle up against the curated registry served by VehicleRegistryController at /api/public/vehicle-registry/vehicles/{vin}; the response (value, year, fuel type, etc.) feeds the auto-approval DMN.

userTasks.name: Submit owner & vehicle details
userTasks.description: The registering owner confirms (or corrects) their details, picks a vehicle from the catalog (a VIN), and uploads their ID document. The owner's name and email are filled automatically from their signed-in account — do NOT collect or send them. Call upload_document FIRST to stage the ID file, then pass the returned object as `pendingIdDocument` here. Typically the LLM only needs to gather age, the VIN, and the document, then call complete_task.

requiredDocuments.description: Copy of the owner's national ID card, passport, or driving licence. The Transport Authority reviewer will download this during review.

objectId.description: Vehicle VIN, matched against the curated registry.

additionalOwners.description: Optional list of co-owners that must sign the registration before it reaches Transport Authority review. Leave empty unless the owner explicitly asks for it. Note: the co-owner sign-off flow uses applicantEmail + per-owner tracking links and is best driven from the web portal — MCP does not surface the sign-off receive task today.

pendingIdDocument.description: Reference to an ID document staged via the upload_document tool. Required. Shape exactly matches the upload_document response.

userTasks.name: Transport Authority review
userTasks.description: The Transport Authority reviewer accepts the registration or sends it back to the owner with a reason. A non-interrupting timer fires every two minutes while this task is open and sends a reminder email via Mailpit. If sent back, the process loops to the owner's owner-vehicle task.

decision.description: approve = end the process as approved. sendback = email the owner with the reason and loop back to the owner-vehicle task.

sendBackReason.description: Required when decision = sendback. The owner sees this as a banner above the owner-vehicle form on re-entry.
